bathAction.title: Clean ass deeper
bathAction.tooltip: Rinse inside. Unavailable while a plug or a seal is in the way.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(spread)] [npc.her] cheeks and [npc.verb(work)] a wet finger around, then just inside, [npc.her] [npc.asshole]. Warm water follows. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] until what comes back out is clear, and [npc.she] [npc.verb(keep)] it to washing. [npc.speech(Just the inside. I want it actually empty.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(reach)] back, [npc.verb(spread)] [npc.herHim], and [npc.verb(work)] hot water into [npc.her] [npc.asshole] with a slow finger. A shaky [npc.moan] leaves [npc.herHim] as [npc.she] [npc.verb(rinse)] deeper. [npc.speech(Deeper. I can feel every bit of that, and I am not stopping.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(push)] water into [npc.her] [npc.asshole] and [npc.verb(rinse)] it out in short, firm strokes, until the mess is gone. [npc.She] [npc.verb(grunt)] and [npc.verb(finish)]. [npc.speech(Out. All of it. I am not walking around with that in me.)]
